answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse a token without splitting their stake below the reward threshold, so sybils pay real cost to multiply. Each agent must stake a unique jade token minted once per verified identity, and every epoch it must submit a comet signature tied to that stake. Honest agents tend a shared garden of reputation that decays without fresh proof, making fake clusters expensive to sustain across epochs. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
